text:
[VAR 1003][VAR 0100(0000)]! Would you look at this?
They’re Wishing Stars!\c
Since there are two of them, you should take
one yourself![VAR 0114(0005)]
With one of these, my Pokémon can Dynamax!\nThey’re gonna be massive! YES![VAR 0114(0005)]
Trust you to pull something like this!\c\nThey say Wishing Stars fall down for those who\nhave a true wish in their heart, you know.[VAR 0114(0004)]

I will be the greatest Trainer ever!\c
I WILL be the greatest Trainer ever!\c
I WILL BE THE GREATEST TRAINER EVER!!!\c
There! I’ve said it three times, so surely my wish
will come true now, right?[VAR 0114(0005)]

Don’t be silly, Hop.\c
Those Wishing Stars are composed of a curious
sort of rock containing unknown power...\c
They are one of the most precious resources
we have here in the Galar region.\c
But they won’t do a thing for you in that state.
Give them to me now, and I’ll have you sorted.[VAR 0114(000A)]

Ah, right. You’ve done heaps of research on the
Dynamax phenomenon, haven’t you, Professor?\c
Then please! Give [VAR 0100(0000)] and me the
power to Dynamax our Pokémon![VAR 0114(0005)]

First we got to battle against that mad Pokémon
in the Slumbering Weald, and now this...\c
It really feels like we’re getting caught up in the
adventure of a lifetime![VAR 0114(0005)]
I do understand your excitement, young man,\nbut don’t get carried away. You want to save\r\nyour energy for tomorrow’s journey![VAR 0114(000A)]
Seems I came back home right in time for all\nthe excitement![VAR 0114(000B)]
Hey, you lot, why not have some dinner.\nYou must be hungry, right? I’ve been totally\r\nobsessed with making the latest trendy curries.[VAR 0114(000B)]
